mapper.sql: select t.teacher_id, t.teacher_no, t.teacher_name, t.teacher_type, t.dept_id, t.homeroom_dept_id, t.user_id, t.mobile, t.gender, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, d.dept_name from spas_teacher t left join sys_dept d on t.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: select teacher_id, teacher_no from spas_teacher where teacher_no = #{teacherNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and del_flag = '0'
where t.del_flag = '0' and t.status = '0' and t.teacher_type = #{teacherType} order by t.teacher_name asc, t.teacher_id asc
where t.del_flag = '0' and t.teacher_type = #{teacherType} and t.dept_id = #{deptId} order by t.teacher_id asc

where t.del_flag = '0' and ( t.homeroom_dept_id = #{deptId} or (t.teacher_type = '2' and t.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.homeroom_dept_id is null) ) order by case when t.homeroom_dept_id = #{deptId} then 0 else 1 end, t.teacher_id asc limit 1
where t.del_flag = '0' and t.status = '0' and t.teacher_type in ('1', '2') order by t.teacher_name asc, t.teacher_id asc
mapper.update: update spas_teacher set homeroom_dept_id = #{homeroomDeptId}, update_time = now() where teacher_id = #{teacherId}
